accounts.plan.title: Plan GitHub identity
accounts.plan.summary: Detect accounts, propose a repo identity and render the owner's one-message ask.

accounts.use.title: Approve GitHub identity
accounts.use.summary: Apply the selected account with a relayed approval quote and source, and audit the change.

accounts.decline.title: Decline account management
accounts.decline.summary: Record the owner's relayed refusal for this repo.

accounts.check.title: Check commit identities
accounts.check.summary: Refuse a push range whose author or committer email is not the bound GitHub account's. Defaults to every unpushed commit. Never calls gh.
